items.item_text: Bachelor Degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training
Experience recruiting, hiring, training and supervising student assistants.
Customer service experience and strong interpersonal communication skills to work effectively in a team environment which includes complex challenging situations.
Advanced experience with technical systems and software
Computer experience with Microsoft office suite and data analysis.
Experience working in higher educations, working with student academic services (admission, financial aid, student accounting, college deans, university departments).
Experience implementing higher education rules and regulations.
Experience/Skill working as part of a team by establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with peers, and accomplish office goals.
Experience/Skill making independent decision in accordance with relative policies and procedures.

Reporting to the Student Records Services - Supervisor in Enrollment and Records within the Office of the University Registrar (OUR), the Student Services Officer is responsible for managing Student Services (SS), supervises student employee. Assigns and schedules work, monitors performance, provides training and coaching, evaluates work quality, and ensures adherence to security procedures and customer service expectations. Student Services Officer is responsible for promoting and advancing the student registration and enrollment programs and participating in outreach that will enhance the student experience. Oversees the front counter station and up to 30 student assistant that provide frontline service. Functions as the lead to recruit, train, supervise, motivate, and evaluate the student assistants of the student services area. The Office of the University Registrar serves as a link between the students and the university and motivates students who participate in various activities while in school.
Working knowledge of Family Education Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) of 1974
